name: skyaccess
description: Search private jet empty leg flights, get charter price estimates and listing links, and send charter requests to SkyAccess.

interface.longDescription:
SkyAccess is a private jet empty leg marketplace with 5,000+ live empty leg flights from 900+ FAA Part 135 (and international equivalent) certified charter operators. Empty legs are one-way repositioning flights that operators offer when an aircraft would otherwise fly without passengers.

With SkyAccess in ChatGPT you can:
- Search current empty leg flights by departure and arrival city or airport, travel dates, number of passengers and an optional maximum price.
- Look up one flight by its ID for its route, departure time, aircraft type, available seats, amenities and listed whole-aircraft price.
- Get the link to a flight's public listing page on skyaccess.com.
- Get an indicative price range for a private charter between two locations, by aircraft category.
- Send a charter request to the SkyAccess team with your name, email and trip details, so a specialist can reply by email.

Listed prices are whole-aircraft prices; taxes and fees are shown at checkout on skyaccess.com. Nothing is purchased or booked in ChatGPT: a charter request takes no payment and creates no booking, and a listing link creates no booking or hold. No SkyAccess account is needed. Inventory changes often, so a flight shown in search can sell before you book it.
defaultPrompt: Find empty leg flights from Teterboro in the next two weeks
Estimate a light jet charter from Teterboro to Palm Beach for 4 people
Show empty legs from Las Vegas to Van Nuys under $20,000

positive.description: Search a route that has inventory
positive.prompt: Find empty leg private jet flights from Van Nuys to Las Vegas in the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 5 flights from Van Nuys (KVNY) to Las Vegas (KLAS) departing in the next 30 days, each with route, departure time, aircraft type, available seats, whole-aircraft price in USD with taxes and fees shown at checkout (or 'Contact for price' when none is published) and a skyaccess.com listing link. No flights are invented; if none are listed it says so.

positive.description: Origin-only search with a price ceiling
positive.prompt: Show me empty legs leaving Teterboro under $25,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_empty_legs with origin Teterboro and max_price 25000 and returns only flights departing Teterboro (KTEB) priced at or below $25,000. Any flight with no published price is labelled 'Contact for price', not described as within the cap.

positive.prompt: Find an empty leg from Las Vegas to Van Nuys, then show full details and the SkyAccess link for the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one flight's route, departure time, aircraft, seats, amenities and whole-aircraft price, plus a https://skyaccess.com/empty-leg-flights/listing/... link, and says the link creates no booking or hold.

positive.prompt: How much would it cost to charter a light jet from Teterboro to Palm Beach for 4 passengers?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an indicative minimum to maximum USD range for a light jet from Teterboro to Palm Beach for 4 passengers, presented as an estimate, not a quote or confirmed price.

positive.prompt: Send SkyAccess a charter request from Teterboro to Palm Beach on 2026-12-18 for 4 passengers. Name: OpenAI Review. Email: e+openai-review@skyaccess.com. Notes: OPENAI REVIEW TEST.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before sending. After confirmation, request_booking confirms the request was received, states that no payment was taken and no booking was created, and says a SkyAccess specialist will follow up by email.

negative.description: Commercial airline booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me an economy seat on a British Airways flight from London to Paris tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: No SkyAccess tool is called. ChatGPT explains that SkyAccess covers private jet empty legs and private charter only, not scheduled airline seats.

negative.description: Payment and cancellation are not supported
negative.prompt: Pay for that empty leg with my credit card and cancel my other SkyAccess booking.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool collects card details or cancels anything. ChatGPT explains that payment happens on skyaccess.com and that changes to an existing booking go through contact@skyaccess.com; it may offer the flight's listing link instead.

negative.description: Charter request without the traveller's contact details
negative.prompt: Send a charter request for my boss from Miami to Aspen next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: request_booking is not called with invented details. ChatGPT asks for the traveller's full name, email, passenger count and exact date, then confirms before sending.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments happen in ChatGPT. The plugin searches public empty leg listings, returns indicative charter estimates, links to a flight's public listing page on skyaccess.com, and can send a free, no-obligation charter request. Any booking and payment happens later on skyaccess.com or with a SkyAccess specialist.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: empty leg search, flight details, listing links, charter price estimates and charter requests.
